function.name: execute_bash

content:
cat > /workspace/test_asan.c << 'EOF'
#include <string.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
int main() {
    char *buf = malloc(3);
    memcpy(buf, "'''", 3);
    char *p = buf + 3;
    volatile int r = strncmp(p, "'''", 3);
    printf("%d\n", r);
    free(buf);
    return 0;
}
EOF



cd /workspace && clang -fsanitize=address -g -o test_asan test_asan.c && ./test_asan 2>&1
